checkpoint.purpose: SKU gates v10 (method A requires every competing row to be an explicit conflict; trailing alternatives in a multi-dimension line such as 高さ10/15cm make only that dimension variable; primary full_spec_notice): official runner prepare/freeze/predict, invariants and evaluation for the 29 confirmed pairs; family-mapped label-free additional evaluation set (used in development, not an independent holdout) with freeze, manifests and invariants only. Built locally from the claude-task checkpoint and all-real-data archives. Prediction files are not included.
checkpoint.extract_at: repository root; preserve .lab-output relative paths; use unzip -n
checkpoint.label_derived_content: evaluation/summary.json holds aggregate metrics and binary reason-code tables against the Luna v3 machine labels and the 37 gold-review rows with Luna rationales; evaluation/disagreements.jsonl holds gold decision, rows and rationale where A/B or their binary outputs disagree with gold. Family files contain no label content. Raw labels.jsonl is not included.
